data.title: Telling Time to the Hour and Half Hour

challenges.instruction: Look at the clock. What time is it?
challenges.hint: The short hour hand is pointing straight at the 3, and the long minute hand is pointing up at the 12.

challenges.instruction: Check the clock hands. What time does this show?
challenges.hint: The long minute hand has gone halfway around the clock to the 6. Where is the short hour hand pointing?

challenges.instruction: Read the time shown on the clock face.
challenges.hint: Think about what time you usually eat breakfast or go to sleep. The hour hand is on the 9.

challenges.instruction: Can you tell what time is on this clock?
challenges.hint: The short hand is halfway between the 1 and the 2. The long hand is pointing straight down at the 6.

challenges.instruction: Look closely at the hands to find the correct time.
challenges.hint: When both hands point straight up to the top, it is the very start of a new hour.

data.description: Learn to read analog clocks to the exact hour and half hour using easy-to-understand visual clues.
